stockBatchConsumptionsUniqueIndexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX stock_batch_consumptions_pkey ON public.stock_batch_consumptions USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_batch_consumption_line ON public.stock_batch_consumptions USING btree (tenant_id, processing_order_no, batch_id, order_item_id, reason) WHERE (deleted = 0)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_batch_consumption_stocktake ON public.stock_batch_consumptions USING btree (tenant_id, stocktake_run_id, batch_id) WHERE ((stocktake_run_id IS NOT NULL) AND (deleted = 0))
